message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best websites to find **free 3D game assets** (models, textures, animations, and more) for your projects:

---

## **Top All-Rounders (Multiple Asset Types)**

| Site | What You Get | License | Best For |
|------|-----------|---------|----------|
| **Kenney** | 40,000+ 2D sprites, 3D models, UI, fonts, audio | CC0 (public domain) | Consistent art style, rapid prototyping |
| **itch.io** | Asset packs, complete game kits, sprites, audio | Varies (many CC0) | Indie games, complete kits |
| **OpenGameArt.org** | 2D art, 3D models, music, sound effects | CC0, CC-BY, GPL | Open-source projects, variety |

---

## **3D Models**

| Site | What You Get | License | Best For |
|------|-----------|---------|----------|
| **Quaternius** | Low-poly stylized characters, animals, vehicles, environments, weapons | CC0 | Stylized/low-poly 3D games |
| **Poly Haven** | Realistic 3D props, environment pieces, HDRIs | CC0 | Realistic environments, lighting |
| **Meshy** | AI-generated 3D models in multiple formats | CC0 (free commercial use) | Quick custom assets, prototyping |
| **Sketchfab** | Huge variety of downloadable 3D models | Varies (many CC0/CC-BY) | Browsing/previewing before download |
| **PolyScann** | Game-ready buildings, medieval props, industrial assets | CC0 | Unity projects, level design |
| **Clara.io** | 100,000+ free 3D models (architecture, vehicles, robots) | Varies | General 3D models |
| **Open3DModel** | Game characters, environments, consoles, beasts | Varies | Specific game categories |

---

## **Textures & Materials (PBR)**

| Site | What You Get | License | Best For |
|------|-----------|---------|----------|
| **ambientCG** | 2,000+ PBR materials, HDRIs, 3D models | CC0 | Realistic PBR textures up to 8K |
| **CGBookcase** | High-quality PBR textures with tutorials | CC0 | Learning texture workflows |
| **FreeStylized** | 150+ stylized 4K textures | Free | Stylized game art |
| **Scenario Lab AI** | AI-generated seamless textures with PBR maps | Free library available | Custom texture generation |

---

## **Characters & Animations**

| Site | What You Get | License | Best For |
|------|-----------|---------|----------|
| **Mixamo** | Rigged characters + motion-capture animations | Free commercial use | Character animation, auto-rigging |

---

## **Key Tips**

- **CC0 = most permissive**: Use commercially, no attribution needed
- **Always check licenses** before publishing (especially on Sketchfab, itch.io, and TurboSquid)
- **Common game-ready formats**: FBX, OBJ, GLB/GLTF, with PBR maps (albedo, normal, roughness, metallic)

---
